what: A solve of the RIVERS M1.1 test valley (48 m by 14 m, 0.3 m3/s) at 0.25 m cells, from pools filled to their sills, to the first profile's stopping rule.

load.note: Other builders share this Mac, so seconds are noisy; cell updates are exact.

part5_comparison.words: The valley takes 8020 steps and 20.5 million cell updates for 2088 wet cells, 9798 updates a wet cell. Part 5 estimated 24,267 steps for a 350 m stream, 24286 updates a wet cell, scaled from a 120 m section; the valley is 40 m long, so it needs fewer steps for its signals to cross it, and its updates also count the dry cells beside the water that each step works on.
